plus18Description: GAMBLING IS A RECREATIONAL ACTIVITY THAT SHOULD BE UNDERTAKEN IN MODERATION AND ONLY WITH MONEY THAT YOU CAN AFFORD TO LOSE.
fullText: CrownBet wants to ensure that you enjoy wagering in moderation, as a form of entertainment, in a safe and secure environment. We are here to help you keep your gambling expenditure in balance.
listTitle1: We want you to have fun, but always stay in control of your spending. This website has several tips and tools to help you do this:
list1:
• Deposit limits – for control over how much you spend with pre-committed limits;
  • Take a Break – to give you greater control by taking time out from betting;
  • Self-assessment tools – a calculator and questionnaire to make sure gambling remains in balance;
contentLine1: CrownBet does not want you to gamble with money you can’t afford to lose.
contentLine2: If you feel you are not in control of your wagering, and would like immediate help, you can find support services here.

panelContent.title: SELF ASSESSMENT
panelContent.shortText: Get a better picture of your gambling and make sure you keep it in balance. Go through the questionnaire or use the gambling calculator...

panelContent.title: TAKE A BREAK
panelContent.shortText: It’s important to take regular breaks from wagering. It’s easy to do so with Take A Break where you can take time out for a period of your choosing...

panelContent.title: GETTING HELP
panelContent.shortText: There are many ways you can obtain support including by phone, on the web or in person. It’s free and easier than you may think...
